# Restaurant ordering PWA

*Client industry: food & beverage | Completed: 2025-02-16 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p07*

## The problem
The client was a restaurant group paying 30% commission to delivery apps.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using a component-based single-page frontend, TypeScript, card payments and recurring subscriptions, Node.js. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project shifted 25% of orders to direct ordering.
